title: Environmental Storytelling, Contextual Lore & Episodic Quest DAGs
core_competencies: Environmental narrative: storytelling embedded in physical space (abandoned carts, bread queues, curfew edicts).
Stateful quest DAGs: multi-act quests that react to player choice, economic shortages, and faction standing.
Low-fantasy vernacular: grounded medieval dialogue free from modern idioms and tech metaphors.
NPC personality profiles: distinct speech pitches, schedules, and moral stances toward the Clerisy and curfew.
anti_patterns: Linear fetch-quest checklists with no systemic consequences.
Static exposition dumps unlinked to world events.
